source.title: Isolated Mononeuropathy From Rucksack Palsy: A Case Series

extraction_limitations: This is a three-case series without a comparator group, systematic ascertainment, or standardized exposure measurement.
The article combines original case observations with a narrative review. Secondary claims are tagged and are not represented as if the case series generated them.
Several electrodiagnostic findings are qualitative because the article does not report numeric amplitudes or reference ranges.
No bibliography entries were treated as evidence atoms. The reference list is exported separately as a task queue.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
schema_gaps: The schema has no dedicated case-report/case-series result kind or secondary-reported-result kind; qualitative_result and other plus tags were used without changing the schema.
external_verification: Not performed. The user did not activate @VERIFY.
